import os, math

def ensure_spotify_access_token():
    creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
    spotify_pw = [c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
    return apis.spotify.login(username='ka_burt@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)['access_token']


def artists_to_str(artists):
    return '|'.join([a.get('name','') for a in (artists or [])])


def csv_escape(val):
    s = str(val) if val is not None else ''
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',', '\n', '\r', '"']):
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return s


access_token = ensure_spotify_access_token()

# Collect song_ids from song library (also grab details to avoid extra calls)
song_details_by_id = {}

def fetch_song_library_song_ids_and_details():
    details = {}
    ids = set()
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        for item in page:
            sid = item.get('song_id')
            if sid is None:
                continue
            ids.add(sid)
            title = item.get('title','')
            artists_str = artists_to_str(item.get('artists'))
            details[sid] = (title, artists_str)
        page_index += 1
    return ids, details

song_ids_songlib, song_details_by_id = fetch_song_library_song_ids_and_details()
print('songlib_song_ids', len(song_ids_songlib))

# Album library song_ids
album_song_ids=set()
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=access_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for a in page:
        for sid in (a.get('song_ids') or []):
            album_song_ids.add(sid)
    page_index += 1
print('album_song_ids', len(album_song_ids))

# Playlist library song_ids (public + private)

def fetch_playlist_song_ids(is_public):
    ids=set()
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, query='', is_public=is_public, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        for p in page:
            for sid in (p.get('song_ids') or []):
                ids.add(sid)
        page_index += 1
    return ids

playlist_song_ids_public = fetch_playlist_song_ids(True)
playlist_song_ids_private = fetch_playlist_song_ids(False)

print('final_details_count', len(song_details_by_id))

# Build CSV content
rows = []
for sid,(title,artists_str) in song_details_by_id.items():
